notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 31 ± 3 MPa, elongation 7.5 ± 1.3 %, bending modulus 2370 ± 150 MPa, bending strength 59 ± 6 MPa, impact 13.8 ± 0.9 kJ/m²) are not stored.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2580 ± 220 MPa, Z 2060 ± 170 MPa), melt index (23.2 ± 3.5 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), saturated water absorption rate (0.43 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (30 mm), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (50 - 60 °C, 6 - 12 h). The support material ("Support for PLA") is a relation.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

Printed-specimen results and raw-material properties stay apart: mechanical.* holds only printed-specimen values (with the specimen printing conditions in test_condition); material.density, thermal.melting_temp and thermal.glass_transition are material properties (ISO 1183, DSC). The TDS does not say how the Vicat (ISO 306) and HDT (ISO 75) specimens were made (its Specimen Test drawings cover tensile, bending and impact only); their test_condition says so. The registry has no separate *.printed / *.material keys.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament.

Adjudication against the second extraction (96 field disagreements, every one re-read in the cached documents): 55 are the same fact written differently (54 locator separators/wording for the same TDS cell, hex cell or wiki row, and the nozzle relation label "nozzles" vs "nozzle"); this file's form is kept. Every hex cell was re-read (name, row, column, code) and every hex scope id matches its store colour value. thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the TDS 1.8 MPa row (54 °C), the load every other filament file stores; the 0.45 MPa row (57 °C) is in its note. material.net_weight is written as 1 kg, the TDS's own figure (mergeCurated stores 1000 g with the text "1 kg"). Taken from the second extraction after reading the documents: extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters (TDS p.1 Nozzle Size row, as in the ABS, ASA, ABS-GF and PLA-CF files), compatible_with Engineering Plate (material-table wiki, glue required), compatible_with high-flow nozzles (0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm; material-table wiki) and compatible_with Support for PLA (TDS p.2). Not taken: compat.statement (a paraphrase joining two cells of the PLA wiki row, which this file already holds verbatim as the AMS-series relation; the TDS has no Printers Compatibility row, so no other PLA file without one carries the key), the separate AMS and AMS lite relations and the open-frame / enclosed printer relations (the same material-table facts this file holds as the AMS-series family relation and the "Open-frame or enclosed printer" relation, as in the PLA Matte file). Kept from this file after re-reading: the plate target handles (bambu-textured-pei-plate; bambu-smooth-pei-plate, which the material-table wiki heads "Bambu Smooth PEI / High-Temperature Plate"), the "Open-frame or enclosed printer" relation (material-table wiki, 1. Printer) and the refill's requires-spool relation (store page Product Features note).
